comment: Sidechain compressor: compresses the Fx-buffer L signal using R as its detector. Output modes are Sum, Parallel, Comp L, 0Sum, and 0Par. The 0 modes replace RTFM at the group boundary: they use Div0's Dry R signal as the sidechain and route compressed L plus R as a mono sum or separate L/R signals for a following effects group. Use Div0 first, then group 1, Pump It, and group 2; do not also use RTFM. Includes five compressor-inspired responses, a linked output safety limiter, and a live 0-24 dB gain-reduction needle meter. Intended for MS-70CDR 2.10 at 44.1 kHz.

params.name: Thrs
params.comment: Sidechain threshold, approximately -80 dBFS to -12 dBFS.

params.name: Rat
params.comment: Compression from 1:1 to 100:1, blending smoothly into Duck over the top 10% of knob travel. At maximum, displays Duck and hard-mutes the compressed signal when the sidechain reaches twice Threshold.

params.name: Make
params.comment: Post-compression makeup gain from 0 to approximately +24 dB for stronger pumping.

params.name: Mode
params.comment: 0Sum and 0Par use Div0's Dry R signal as the key; they route compressed Fx L plus R as mono or separate L/R signals.

params.name: LLev
params.comment: Output level for compressed L (and its contribution in Sum), 0 to 4x.

params.name: RLev
params.comment: Output level for the R signal (Sum, Parallel, 0Sum, and 0Par), 0 to 4x.
